title: App-driver contract, format 1 (quality spec #qc-contract, docs/adr/0025): qc.toml at a target's root
description: Keys follow annotateanything's qa.toml where they fit. Commands run under sh with QC_REPO set to the repo root; no key names a path on this box (#evidence-portable).

format.description: This contract's format version: picks schemas/qc.v<format>.schema.json

setup.description: Installs or builds the app once, run from the repo root

command.description: The app command a user runs; a drive appends its arguments and runs it from the drive's own working directory

services.description: Services the app needs, by name; empty for an app with none

command.description: Starts the service, run from the repo root

ready.description: How the service is known to be ready: the path its URL answers on

fixture.description: Fixtures, by name; empty for an app that keeps no data

reset.description: Resets the fixture, run from the repo root before a drive

path.description: Where the fixture's data lives, relative to the repo root

values.description: Named values criteria refer to and drives use

demo.description: Each criterion's demo, keyed by its criterion id <spec>#<anchor> (the spec's file stem and the criterion's anchor). `just qc` runs a claimed criterion's demo at the exact head in the qc sandbox, stores its command, exit status and output in the evidence store, and its exit status is the demo's own checks: 0 passes, any other fails (quality spec #qc-run). Absent or empty: no criterion has a demo. Added compatibly to format 1: a contract without it reads as before

command.description: Drives the criterion and runs its checks, run under sh from the repo root with QC_REPO set; it does its own setup and fixture resets; its exit status reports its checks

browser.description: True when the demo drives a headless browser (the [browser] key's pin); default false

covers.description: The code paths the demo covers, relative to the repo root

tests.description: The tests that enforce the criterion, as the repo's test runner names them (paths relative to the repo root, or test ids)

browser.description: Present only when the verify skill drives a headless browser: Playwright's headless Chromium shell, installed once per box where `just install-check` names, which a drive reaches by PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH (remote spec #host-tools)

playwright.description: The Playwright release the verify skill pins, whose headless Chromium shell it drives
